# Sound Bath

> Sound Bath is an ambient music project by music producer Andrew Heringer, based in California. It releases music for sleep, meditation, solfeggio frequencies, binaural beats, and nature sounds. This site, soundbathvibrations.com, is the project's official website.

"Sound Bath" (capitalized) is the name of the music project. A "sound bath" (lowercase) is the general listening practice of resting while sustained tones play. The FAQ explains both.

Sound Bath does not claim that specific frequencies heal, and its recordings are not medical treatments. Where research exists, the FAQ links to it; where it does not, the FAQ says so.

## Pages

- [FAQ](https://soundbathvibrations.com/faq/): Plain answers on sound baths, solfeggio frequencies, binaural beats, music for sleep and stress, how to listen, and who makes Sound Bath. Cites its sources.
- [About](https://soundbathvibrations.com/about/): Who makes Sound Bath and how it started.
- [Catalog](https://soundbathvibrations.com/catalog/): The four collections.
- [Solfeggio](https://soundbathvibrations.com/solfeggio/): Solfeggio frequency tracks, 396 Hz to 963 Hz.
- [Sleep](https://soundbathvibrations.com/sleep/): Music for sleep, including theta wave tracks.
- [Nature](https://soundbathvibrations.com/nature/): Rain, ocean, river, and forest recordings.
- [Meditation](https://soundbathvibrations.com/meditation/): Drone and binaural beat music for meditation and yoga.
- [Connect](https://soundbathvibrations.com/connect/): Contact form.

## The artist

- [Andrew Heringer](https://www.andrewheringer.com/): Music producer and singer-songwriter. Also releases indie and alternative music under his own name and as [The Guest and The Host](https://www.theguestandthehost.com/).
